# IL1120-7200-4 e-file error

```
IL1120-7200-4: FormIL1120 Step 5 Line 38 must equal either SchIL1120NLD Step 1 Line 7 Box or SchIL1120UBNLD Step 3 Line 30.
```

Net operating loss (NOL) information must be entered at the subsidiary level rather than the TopCon level.

## Solution

To resolve:

- In the TopCon locator, go to **Organizer**, **States**, **Illinois**, **Net Operating Losses**, and then **NOL - Single Company**. Remove all entries.
- Next, go into each subsidiary locator.
- Go to **Organizer**, **States**, **Illinois**, **Net Operating Losses**, **NOL - Parent**, and then **Subsidiary**.
- In the **Parent and Subsidiary Information** section, complete the **Loss apportionable to Illinois (enter as a negative number)** field.
- Perform a full recompute for each subsidiary.
- Reconsolidate the TopCon, recreate and resubmit the e-file.

tip

If these steps don't resolve the error, delete previously transferred state data by going to **Organizer**, **States**, **State Combined Returns**, and then **State Consolidation Steps**, **Step 6**. Reconsolidate, recreate and resubmit the e-file.

## Solution 2

Make sure Form IL-1120, line 38 and Schedule NLD, line 7 matches:

- Go to Tax Forms, then **States** and select **Illinois**.
- Select **IL-1120-Income and Replacement Tax**.
- On IL-1120, Page 3 , note the amount on Step 5 Line 38.
- Go to the**Sch NLD-Net Loss Deduction** area, then select **Sch NLD, Page 1**.
- Make sure Step 1 line 7, matches IL-1120, Step 5, line 38.

## Solution 3

If the amounts match and the error still exists:

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Illinois**.
- In **Return Options**, review the **Print Suppression** section.
- Make sure Schedules NLD or UB, NLD box is unchecked.

articles.title: IL1120B-2700-4 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# IL1120B-2700-4 e-file error

## Error

```
If the partner or shareholder is a disregarded entity for federal income tax purposes (ex: grantor trust, single member LLC, etc), then the owner of the disregarded entity s information and designation should be entered as the partner or shareholder for purposes of the schedule B. Example, if the partner or shareholder is a grantor trust and is owned by an individual, then the partner or shareholder should be designated as an I for individual. This will help to insure the proper amount of pass-through withholding will be calculated for nonresident partners and shareholders. (IL1120-2700-4)
```

## Cause

On Schedule B, Page 2, any shareholder that has a code A, C, M, N, P, or S under Column B can't have an SSN entered under Column C.

## Solution

- In the **Organizer**, select **Shareholder Information**.
- Choose **Shareholder Data**, then **Shareholder Information**.
- Check each shareholder's information. If the shareholder is a Trust, mark the **Format Shareholder I.D. as EIN** checkbox.
- Do a Full Recompute, recreate the e-file, and resubmit the return.

# IL1120ST-2600-2 e-file error

```
Form IL-1120-ST (Rule IL1120ST-2600-2): If Form IL-1120-ST Step 2, Ordinary Income or Loss, or Equivalent from Federal Schedule K is present, then IRS-1120S must be attached.
```

This e-file error will show if there is no federal copy attached to the XML.

## Solution 1

- Within the **Organizer**, select **States** then **State E-File**.
- Select **Enable/Create Returns**.
- On the **Federal Copy** tab, select **Illinois**.
- Make sure that the **Federal XML** has been created and qualified.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

## Solution 2

- In **Organizer**, select **States** then **Common State**.
- Select **General Information** then**Basic Return Information**.
- On the**Signature Information** tab, go to column K and enter a **Signature date** for the Illinois row.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

## Solution 3

- Within the **Organizer**, select **States** then **Illinois**.
- Select **State Adjustments**, then **Additions and Subtractions**.
- Go to the 

  Subtractions

   section and make sure there isn't a description entered in the **Other subtractions** field with no **Amount**.
- If there is, either add an amount or remove the description.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

Per the e-file schema provided by Illinois, the return will need to be filed out of the correct software (locator) version or paper filed.

articles.title: ILSCHUB-20900-2 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# ILSCHUB-20900-2 e-file error

```
ILSCHUB-20900-2 path to XML Error /ns:ReturnState/ns:ReturnDataState/ns:SchIL1120UB/ns:SchUBMembershipTable/ns:Step3ColABCTaxableInc/ns:ApportionedNetAmount See Schedule UB instructions for SchIL1120UB Step 4 Line 2 to understand how to handle eliminations in UB Step 4. Do not create an eliminations column.
```

enter cause and intro (e.g. "This happens when" or "You get this error when")

## Solution

- In the TopCon, go to **Organizer**, **States**, **Illinois**, and then **Net Operation Losses**.
- Remove any NOL detail entered. This information should be entered at the member level.
- Still in the TopCon, go to **Organizer**, **States**, **State Combined Returns**, **State Consolidation Steps**, and then **Step 6**.
- Select the **Delete previously transferred state data**.
- Select **Illinois**, **Consolidated Returns**, **Step 4 - Review Preconsol Checklist**, Out of balance and compute pending, and then Compute all subsidiaries.
- Next, go to Organizer, Consolidated Returns, Step 5 - Consolidate!, and then Consolidate.

erlink | Click "Illinois" Organizer | Consolidated Returns | Step 4 - Review Preconsol Checklist | Out of balance and compute pending | Compute all subsidiaries now Organizer | Consolidated Returns | Step 5 - Consolidate! | Consolidate NOTE: This is an Alert that can be disregarded. This alert does not require any further activity. Illinois sends alerts back with every return, no matter if it's accepted or rejected.

The Illinois DOR sends e-file Alerts along with their rejects. The Schedule UB, Step 4 eliminations messages are alerts and do not have to be cleared to get an accepted e-file. The application prevents Schedule UB Step 4, rejects by blocking A&A data in the eliminations locator from flowing to Step 4. # FIT-20-013 e-file error

```
If Line 16d INApportPercentage is zero, then Line 17 INApportBusIncome must equal zero.

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Indiana**.
- Select **Allocation and Apportionment**.
- In the Overrides section, enter data for **Apportionment percentage** (100% is invalid; if e-filing leave blank).
- Perform a full recompute and recreate e-file.

  note

  If no values are anticipated forIT-20, PG 1 line 16d and line 17, enter None on IT-20, PG 3 - Part I line 9, then do a full recompute and recreate e-file.

articles.title: E-file diagnostic: LA-Payment amount
articles.body_md:
# E-file diagnostic: LA-Payment amount

```
LA-Payment Amount: The Financial Transaction payment does not equal the Balance Due on Louisiana. Reason: You can't submit a Louisiana return unless there is a payment due.
```

This happens when the financial transaction payment doesn’t equal the balance due.

## Solution

If no payment is due, the return won't be filed, since this is an automatic process. If you're submitting a payment, you need to enter all the required information. Bank information is mandatory to e-file. If you want to pay by check/EFT, you need to paper file the return.

- In Organizer, select 

  **States****Common State****General Information****Bank Information**

  .
- Select the**Debit**tab.
- Enter information in the columns Account Type, Routing Number, Account Number, Date to be Debited, Amount to be Debited, and Authorization to Debit.
- Perform a full compute and create the return.

articles.body_md:
# Form 500-01391-011 e-file error

```
1120 Maryland Form 500-01302-011: Line 13 must be equal to line 12 if line 12 Is present, otherwise must be equal to line 10. If negative, enter 0.

- In Tax Forms, select **States**, then **Maryland**.
- Select **Form 500**, then **Form 500 Page 2**.
- Line 13 should match line 12, if line 12 has a value.
- If line 12 has no value, then line 13 should match line 10.

  note

  You need to remove any overrides on lines 10, 12 or 13.

## Solution 2

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Maryland**, then **Return Options**.
- In the Compute Options section, select **Unistate corporation** (this suppresses Form 500 Page 2m line 11 and Form 511/510, line 31/3b).

## Solution 3

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Maryland**, then **Allocation and Apportionment**.
- In the Apportionment Method section, cancel the selection **Apportionment Factor is Zero**.

breadcrumb: E-file diagnostic: Schedule A, Line 1a(g1) and Schedule A, Line 2e(1)
articles.body_md:
# E-file diagnostic: Schedule A, Line 1a(g1) and Schedule A, Line 2e(1)

```
XML Error Checking: Rule Number: Schedule A, Line 1a(g1)Description: Schedule A, Line 1a(g1) is populatedattach'OtherIncomeSched.pdf'.To attach a PDF: Navigation Edit Insert EFile attachmentsXML Error Checking: Rule Number: Schedule A, Line 2e(1)Description: Schedule A, Line 2e(1) is populatedattach'TangibleAssetsSched.pdf'.To attach a PDF: Navigation Edit Insert EFile attachments.
```

This happens when Form 500, Page 4 Schedule A line 1A(g) or Line 2e(1) have amounts.

## Solution 1

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Maryland**.
- Select **E-file**, then **Attachments**, then **Summary**.
- Select **Attach PDF**.
- Select **ADD**.
- Go to the **Attachment Jurisdiction** and select **Maryland**.
- Select **Browse for file**.
- Select **Upload**.

note

If these lines have an amount, attach the PDF as described in the diagnostic. Before attaching the PDF, make sure the file name is exactly what is listed in the diagnostic. The file should be named **OtherIncomeSched.pdf** for line 1A(g) and **TangibleAssetsSched.pdf** for line 2e(1).

## Solution 2

If there are no within Maryland amounts for these lines, remove any attachments for these lines.

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Maryland**.
- Select **E-file**, then **Attachments**, then **Summary**.
- Select **Attach PDF** and remove attachments for this line that are not needed.
- Perform a full recompute.
- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Enable/Create Returns**.
- Select **Create** for **Maryland**.

note

Having the attachment when there are no longer any amounts on the lines will trigger the diagnostic.

articles.title: FinTran-98110-030 (500E) e-file error
articles.body_md:
# FinTran-98110-030 (500E) e-file error

Enter bank information for the financial transaction when e-filing a Maryland Form 500E extension with a tax payment amount greater than 0. The system requires payment details to match the tax due on the extension.

## Error message

```
FinTran-98110-030 (500E): State payment in Financial Transaction is required when tax paid with extension is greater than 0. 80210-010: Tax Paid with this Extension - must be equal to Payment Amount on Financial Transaction.
```

## Solution 1: Enter bank information for the extension payment

- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****Maryland****500E-Extension of Time to File Income Tax**

  .
- Confirm the **Tax Paid with Extension** field shows an amount greater than 0. If no amount is due, go to Solution 2.
- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****Common State****General Information****Bank Information****Extension Debit**

   tab.
- Enter the **Routing Number**, **Account Number**, and **Account Type** for the **Maryland** row.
- Run a full recompute and recreate the Maryland e-file extension.

## Solution 2: File directly with the state

- If paying Maryland directly instead of through e-file, submit your extension on the state website or by phone: (866) 859-2254.
- Contact Maryland directly for guidance on e-filing when paying online through their website.

## Solution 3: Paper file the extension

You can paper file the extension.

# PYM-004 e-file error

```
355-7004 was filed with no payment information. According to TIR 15-15 extensions are granted automatically if 50% of the total excise has been paid by the original due date. Form 355-7004 should only be filed if a payment needs to be made in order to satisfy the minimum 50% requirement for the automatic extension.

Form 355-7004 was submitted without a payment.

## Solution

According to TIR 15-15, extensions are granted automatically if 50% of the total excise has been paid by the original due date. Only file Form 355-7004 if a payment needs to be made to satisfy the minimum 50% requirement for the automatic extension. Massachusetts doesn’t accept e-filed extensions without payment. Refer to TIR 15-15 for additional information.

Follow these steps to make a payment with the extension:



- Go to **Organizer**, **States**, **Common State**, **General Information**, **Bank Information**, then the **Extension Debit** tab.
- On the line for Massachusetts, mark **Column B for Authorization to Debit Funds**.
- Complete the following fields:


  * Account Number
  * Amount to be Debited
  * Account Type
  * Date Amount to be Debited
  * Routing Number
- Perform a full recompute, re-create the e-file, then re-submit.

note

For processing payments through the website, you may try removing the debit amount to see if it qualifies, as the system only supports Direct Debit for e-filing. Alternatively, you can paper file the return and pay through the Massachusetts website via EFT. When the Tax Payment Method is grayed out, there is no option to select a different method other than Direct Debit.

# FNRCR-018 e-file error

```
FNRCR-018: The Form MA NRCR must have 2 or more members included on the return.
```

You get this error when a Massachusetts Composite return is created, but 1 or less members are selected for composite.

## Solution

**If you aren't filing the Massachusetts Composite return**

- Go to **Organizer** and select **States** then **State E-file**.
- Select **Enable/Create Returns**.
- On the **Return** tab, clear the checkbox to enable the Massachusetts Composite e-file.
- Do a full recompute to clear the diagnostic.

**If you are filing the Massachusetts Composite return**

For each shareholder that should be included:

- Go to **Organizer** and select **Shareholder Information**, then **Shareholder Data**.
- Select **Shareholder Information**, the folder for the shareholder's name, then **State Shareholders Information**.
- Select the Massachusetts for composite return option.
- Do a full recompute.

articles.title: Error: Field 'ListAvailableLosses' is unexpected
articles.body_md:
# Error: Field 'ListAvailableLosses' is unexpected

This error occurs when the Massachusetts Schedule NOL return contains an unexpected ListAvailableLosses element during XML validation. The error indicates that the schema expects CorpTotalIncome instead of ListAvailableLosses at the specified location.

## Error message

```
1. Validation failed on [FILE_ID]:

Form: SchNOL[1][@documentId='SchNOL] ListAvailableLosses[@documentId='NOLAvailable']
Description: List the available losses by tax year end. Losses may be carried forward up to 20 years. List any available losses from the oldest prior year first. Then list, in descending order, the available loss for each succeeding prior taxable year
LineNumber: Schedule NOL Line 4
Requirement: Expecting CorpTotalIncome
Error: Field 'ListAvailableLosses' is unexpected

Element Name: ListAvailableLosses
XPath: //ListAvailableLosses[@documentId='NOLAvailable']
XML Fragment: ******
Field Key: 124,1904,2,0,0,0,0,0,0
Error Code: c00ce014
Error Reason: Element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}ListAvailableLosses' is unexpected according to content model of parent element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}SchNOL'.
Expecting: {http://www.irs.gov/efile}CorpTotalIncome.
```

## Solution

- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****Massachusetts****State Adjustments**

  .
- In the **Income not subject to apportionment** field, enter **NONE** or the amount.
- Run a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: Error: Field 'CorpTotalIncome' is unexpected
articles.body_md:
# Error: Field 'CorpTotalIncome' is unexpected

Each Sch U-NOL needs either the Date of most recent ownership change or date of incorporation if no change in ownership.

## Error Message

```
Validation failed on:
Form: SchNOL[1][@documentId='SchNOL12345OC1] CorpTotalIncome[1]
Description: Corporations total income allocated or apportioned to Massachusetts for the year
LineNumber: Schedule NOL Line 1
Requirement: Expecting DateOwnershipChange
Error: Field 'CorpTotalIncome' is unexpected
Element Name: CorpTotalIncome
XPath: //SchNOL[@documentId='SchNOL12345OC1']/CorpTotalIncome[1]
XML Fragment: <CorpTotalIncome xmlns="http://www.irs.gov/efile">250001</CorpTotalIncome>
Error Code: c00ce014
Error Reason: Element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}CorpTotalIncome' is unexpected according to content model of parent element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}SchNOL'.
Expecting: {http://www.irs.gov/efile}DateOwnershipChange.
```

## Solution 1: Consolidated returns

- In the TopCon, go to 

  **Organizer****States****Massachusetts****Net Operating Loss**

   .
- Find the **Schedule NOL** section.
- Right-click **Date of most recent ownership change or date of incorporation if no change of ownership (Mandatory)** and select **Subview**.
- In Subview, open any entities missing the date and enter the date of most recent ownership change or date or incorporation if no change in ownership.
- Do a full recompute in each subsidiary and the TopCon.
- Clear any overrides for Date of most recent ownership change on Schedule U-NOL in Tax Forms.
- Recreate the Massachusetts e-file.

## Solution 2: Single entity returns

- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****Massachusetts****Net Operating Loss****Schedule NOL**

  .
- Add a date in the **Date of most recent ownership change or date of incorporation if no change of ownership (Mandatory)** field.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

# Error: The field 'EIN' with value '0', data is missing.

A locator is missing an EIN.

## Error Message

```
Validation failed on:
Form: SchUM[2][@documentId='SchUM12345OC1] MembersNameFID[1]/FID[1]/EIN[1]

Error Reason: '0' violates pattern constraint of '[0-9]{9}'.
The element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}EIN' with value '0' failed to parse.

  **Organizer****General Information****Basic Return Information****Entity Information tab**

   . When the elimination doesn't have an EIN, 99-9999999 is commonly used.

- Do a full recompute, reconsolidate, and recreate the e-file.

breadcrumb: Error: Schedule U-NOL: The date of most recent ownership
articles.body_md:
# Error: Schedule U-NOL: The date of most recent ownership

You'll get this diagnostic if either the date of the most recent ownership change or date or incorporation is missing.

## Error Message

```
Schedule U-NOL: The date of the most recent ownership: If there have been no changes then enter the date of incorporation. Review Return XXXXXX.
```

## Solution

For each entity preparing Schedule U-NOL, you'll need to enter either the **Date of most recent ownership change** or **Date or incorporation** if there was no change in ownership. The diagnostic will list the return number of the entity with the issue after **Review Return**.

- From the TopCon, go to 

  **Organizer****States****Massachusetts****Net Operating Loss**

  .
- Go to the **Schedule NOL** section, then the **Date of most recent ownership change or date or incorporation if no change in ownership (Mandatory)** field.
- Right-click the field, then select **Subview**.
- The 

  Subview

   window will show the return number for each entity. Open any entities missing the date, and enter the date of most recent ownership change or date or incorporation if there was no change in ownership.

  note

  This information has to be entered in **Organizer** and not directly on Schedule U-NOL.
- Recompute each subsidiary.
- Reconsolidate the TopCon.
- Do a full recompute, then print.

# F4893-001 e-file error

```
If Form 4893 is present in the return, Form 4894 must also be present.
```

This happens when the 4893 is being included in the e-file but the 4894 isn't being included. If 4893 line 2 has an amount on it, then the 4894 needs to be included.

## Solution 1

- Go to **Organizer**, then the **States** folder.
- Go to **Michigan**, then the **Shareholder Information** folder.
- Select **Add new Shareholder and Officer Information**.
- Fill out the information for this folder.
- Do a full recompute, and recreate the e-file.

- Go to **Tax Forms**, then the **States** folder.
- Go to **Michigan CIT**, **4893, CIT Small Business Alt. Credit** folder.
- Go to line 2. If there is an amount on the line, then you will have to fill out the 4894 or remove the amount.
- If you don't want the amount on line 2, you can space through the amount.
- Do a full recompute, and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: M4-0015 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# M4-0015 e-file error

```
The parent MN tax ID has been used for more than one entity associated with this tax return.
```

The consolidated return has the same Tax ID entered on the parent and one of the subsidiaries.

## Solution

- Go to **Organizer**, **States**, then **Common state**.
- Select **General information**, then **State / City ID Numbers**.
- On the line for Minnesota: Identification number, right-click on the ID number and look for an ID number on 1 or more of the subsidiaries that is the same as the ID number on the parent. This will need to be changed to be its own unique MN ID Number.


  - If the ID number for a subsidiary is unknown, you can call the MN Business Registration office at: (651) 282-5225 to verify the MN ID Number.
- Do a full recompute, and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: M4-0016(AFF) e-file error
articles.body_md:
# M4-0016(AFF) e-file error

```
The same FEIN has been used for more than one entity associated with this tax return.
```

This happens when duplicate EIN information is entered in the tax return; all EINs must be unique. Additionally, Minnesota mandates a valid 7-digit Tax ID. Zeros and 9s are not permitted.

## Solution 1

To fix duplicate EIN numbers:

- Go to 

  **Organizer****General Information****Basic Return Information**

  .
- Go to the **Entity Information** tab. Right-click and select **Subview**.
- Ensure that no same EIN number is entered for two or more different locators.
- Once you’ve fixed the EIN, reconsolidate the TopCon locator and recreate the e-file.

## Solution 2

To fix Minnesota Tax ID:

- In the lower members, go to 

  **Organizer****States**

  .
- Select **Common States**, **General Information**, then **State/City ID numbers**.
- Enter a valid 7-digit Tax ID for **Minnesota**.
- Do a full recompute on all lower members as well as the TopCon.
- Once you’ve fixed the Tax ID, reconsolidate the TopCon locator and recreate the e-file.

breadcrumb: Error: PaymentMethod ActionNeeded: Field 'PaymentMethod' cannot be empty
articles.body_md:
# Error: PaymentMethod ActionNeeded: Field 'PaymentMethod' cannot be empty

This error occurs when the bank information for Minnesota isn't filled out completely.

## Error message

```
1. Validation failed on: Form: FormM4[1] PaymentMethod[1] Error: PaymentMethod ActionNeeded: Field 'PaymentMethod' cannot be empty Element Name: PaymentMethod EXPath: /ReturnState[1]/ReturnDataState[1]/FormM4[1]/PaymentMethod[1] XML Fragment: Field Key: 126,122,16,0,0,0,0,0,0 Error Code: c00ce011 Error Reason: Element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}PaymentMethod' cannot be empty according to the DTD/Schema.[/STYLE]
```

## Solution

To fix this error, you'll need to enter your payment method and bank information, then recompute and recreate the e-file.

- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****Common State**

  .
- Select 

  **General Information****Bank Information**

  .
- Go to the **Direct Debit** tab, then the row for **Minnesota**.
- Mark the **Authorization to Debit Funds** checkbox in column B.
- Select a **Tax Payment Method** in column C.
- Select an **Account Type** in column D.
- Enter a **Routing number** and **Account number** in columns E and F.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

# Error: Field “NewCorporationOrSMLLCFEIN” is unexpected

This error occurs when e-filing MS Form 83105 with a final return status (sold, merged, or converted to SMLLC). The schema requires the new corporation/SMLLC owner's address before accepting the FEIN.

```

Form: Form83105[1] Status[1]/FinalReturn[1]/SoldMerged[1]/NewCorporationOrSMLLCFEIN[1]
LineNumber: Page 2, Part I, Line 3
Description: If the Corporation has been Sold, Merged or Converted to a Single-Member LLC (SMLLC), Enter the FEIN of the New Existing Corporation or Owner of the SMLLC
ReferenceNumber: 41
Requirement: Expecting NewCorporationOrSMLLCAddress
Error: Field 'NewCorporationOrSMLLCFEIN' is unexpected

Element Name: NewCorporationOrSMLLCFEIN
XPath: /ReturnState[1]/ReturnDataState[1]/Form83105[1]/Status[1]/FinalReturn[1]/SoldMerged[1]/NewCorporationOrSMLLCFEIN[1]
XML Fragment: ******
Field Key: 127,446,9,0,0,0,0,0,0
Error Code: c00ce014
Error Reason: Element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}NewCorporationOrSMLLCFEIN' is unexpected according to content model of parent element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}SoldMerged'.
Expecting: {http://www.irs.gov/efile}NewCorporationOrSMLLCAddress.
```

## Solution

- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****Mississippi****E-file****New Existing Co.**

articles.title: CIT-E104 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# CIT-E104 e-file error

```
* CIT-E104: If page 1, Part I question 3 is Yes and Part I question 6 is checked no and there is a value on line 8, then Schedule NOL must be included. If no box is checked, then Schedule NOL must be attached if a value on line 8 exists.
```

This happens when NOL information is entered in the TopCon and not the member returns, or when you are missing information that is required by the state.

## Solution 1

- Go to **Organizer**, **States**, **Montana**, then **Net Operating Loss**.

  tip

  In this screen, you can right-click and select Subview to check which members have NOL information entered.
- Enter NOL information for each member return.
- For these members in TopCon:


  - Go to **Tax Forms**, **States**, **Montana**, **CIT Combined**, **Sch NOL Combined, Sch NOL (Parent) and/or Sch NOL (Sub) Line 5 Taxable Period of NOL** must be completed.
  - **Line 12 Total separate corporation NOL carryforward to year (Add column B lines 5 through 11)** must be completed. NONE is accepted.
- Perform a full recompute, recreate, and resubmit the e-file.

## Solution 2

- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****Montana**

   folder.
- Select the **CIT Combined, Sch NOL Combined** folder.
- Select **Sch NOL (Parent)** or **SCH NOL(Sub)**.
- Populate **Line 5 Taxable Period of NOL**.
- Populate **Line 12 Total separate corporation NOL carryforward to year** (Add column B lines 5 through 11). Enter **NONE** if there are no amounts in the **Parent or Subsidiary**.
- Enter the **NOL Year Date** and **Date of Incorporation**. Don't enter any negative values. This will populate NOL in the XML.
- Do a full recompute in the subsidiary.
- Consolidate the Topcon.
- Recreate and resubmit the e-file.

articles.title: CIT-E107 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# CIT-E107 e-file error

```
Montana CIT-E107: If an amount is present on Federal Form 1120, line 17, Taxes and licenses, then supporting schedule with the Line 17 taxes breakdown named FederalLine17TaxSchedule.pdf must be attached. Do NOT include spaces in the PDF name. Organizer/States/Montana/E-file/Attachments/Summary/Enable the checkbox once the PDF is attached. If this is not attached with the correct name, your return will be rejected by Montana.
```

This happens when an amount exists on Federal Form 1120, Page 1, Line 17, Taxes, and licenses, then a PDF named FederalLine17TaxSchedule.pdf must be attached.

## Solution

- Verify that an amount exists on the Federal Form 1120 Line 17.
- Go to **Tax Forms**, then select the **Federal** folder.
- Go to **1120-US Corporation Income Tax Return**, then **1120-US Corporation Income Tax Return**, **Page 1**.
- On **line 17**, **Taxes and licenses**, if an amount exists, then **FederalLine17TaxSchedule.pdf** needs to be attached.
- Go to **Organizer**, **States**, then **Montana**.
- Select **E-file**, **Attachments**, **Summary**, and then **Attach PDF**.
- Select **Add**.
- In the **Attachment Jurisdiction**, select **Montana**.
- Select **Browse for File**, and attach the PDF named **FederalLine17TaxSchedule.pdf**.
- Select **Upload**, then select **DONE**.
- On the **Summary** page, check the field **CIT- E107, Attach FederalLine17TaxSchedule.pdf**.
- Select **Compute** or **Full Recompute**.
- Go to **Organizer**, **States** folder, then **Enable/Create Returns**.
- Select **Create** e-file for Montana.

articles.title: CIT-E122 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# CIT-E122 e-file error

## Error

```
Total Montana Receipts (page 11 Schedule K Combined line 3k Column B) must equal page 5 Schedule K Total Receipts Value Column B. (CIT-E122)
```

## Cause

The total receipts for consolidated members that have activities in Montana doesn’t equal the apportionment factor.

## Solution

- In the **Tax Forms**, go to **States**.
- Select **Montana**, then **CIT - Corporation Income Tax Return**.
- Open **Combined/Consolidated Return information**, and go to the **Members of a U.S. Consolidated Group (Sch M Page 6)** section.
- Right-click on **Have any activities in Montana** and mark the checkbox for members that should be included in the Montana XML.
- Consolidate TopCon, recreate the XML, and resubmit the return.

If all members are properly marked and you still receive this rejection, check the following:

- In the **Tax Forms**, go to **States**.
- Select **Montana**, then **CIT - Combined**.
- Go to **Sch K Combined** and check the Schedule K for the parent and all subsidiaries.


  - If there is a Montana Numerator amount, there must be an entry on Line 5(a) – Separate Entity Apportionment Factor.
  - If there isn't, this means that the factor is too small to fit within the prescribed number of decimal places that Montana allows. You will have to enter an override on line 5(a) of “NONE”.

articles.title: FormPTE-k1-e2 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# FormPTE-k1-e2 e-file error

## Error

```
Pass-Through withholding is zero. Withholding is required on all second-tier pass-through entities. Withholding is also required on all owners who are a foreign C Corporation, non-resident individual, trust or estate, or other non-resident entity that 1) has a distributive share of Montana income of $1,000 or more, 2) did not elect to be included in a composite tax return, and 3) did not have a valid Form PT-AGR on file.(FormPTE-K1-E2)
```

## Cause

A Shareholder marked as a Domestic 2nd Tier Pass-Through entity doesn't have an amount on Schedule K-1, Part 5, Line 3b.

## Solution

- In the **Organizer**, go to **States**.
- Select **Montana**, then **Shareholder Information**.
- For each Shareholder who has **Domestic 2nd Tier Pass-Through Entity** marked, complete the following.


  - In **Tax Forms**, go to **States**, then select **Montana**.
  - Select **Schedule K-1**, then the Shareholder's name.
  - On **Schedule K-1, Part 5, Line 3b** enter NONE.
- Do a Full Recompute, recreate the electronic file, and resubmit the return.

- Go to 

  **Organizer****Consolidated Returns**

- Go to 

  **Organizer****Consolidated Returns****Step 4 - Review Preconsol Checklist****Out of balance and compute pending**

  . Select **Compute all Subsidiaries now**.
- Go to 

  **Organizer****Consolidated Returns****Step 5 – Consolidate**

  . In the **Consolidation** section, select **Consolidate**.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

# NEGeneral-0001 e-file error

## Error

```
A return has already been filed for this Nebraska State Id for this tax period end date.
```

## Cause

The e-file database shows this ID has already been used on an accepted return.

## Solution

- In the **Organizer**, go to **States**.
- Open **Nebraska** and select **General Information**.
- Make sure a valid State ID is entered.


  - If the ID is already correct, contact the state to check the ID number for this return.

articles.body_md:
# S3-0002 e-file error

```
GrandTotal_GrTotEstTaxAmt (Column B) must equal the total of all CorpFilingReturn_TotEstTaxAmt, ParentCorp_TotEstAmt, and Subsidiary_TotEstTaxAmt eleements (listed in Column B).
```

This happens when filing a combined Nebraska Form 1120N and consolidation adjustments exist on Form 1120N, Page 1.

## Solution

The state schema doesn't allow consolidation adjustments, so the Nebraska return must be paper filed.

- Go to **Tax Forms**, **States**, then **Nebraska**.
- Select **1120N – Corporate Income Tax Return**, then the **1120N, Pg 2** tab
- Select the drill down arrow ![ ](/content/dam/helpandsupp/en-us/Topics/ONESOURCE-family/images/drill-down.png/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg) on line 25.
- Clear any overrides and use subview to open the subsidiary for which an estimated tax was paid.
- Drill down ![ ](/content/dam/helpandsupp/en-us/Topics/ONESOURCE-family/images/drill-down.png/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg) on the field for **Amount paid**.
- Then Select the **Payments of tax** tab.
- On the line for Nebraska, enter the appropriate amounts for each of the quarters.
- Do a full recompute.
- Close the subsidiary return to go back to the Topcon.
- In Organizer, select **Consolidated returns**.
- Select **Step 5 – Consolidate**, then **Consolidate**.

articles.title: S4-0002 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# S4-0002 e-file error

```
S4-0002: Subtotal_GrossProfitAmt (line 3(I)) must equal the sum of all SingleCorpReport_GrossProfitAmt (line 3a) elements.
```

This happens when filing a combined Nebraska Form 1120N and consolidation adjustments exist on Form 1120N, Page 1 which may cause e-file rejects related to Schedule IV.

## Solution

- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****Nebraska****Form 1120N-Corporate Income Tax Return, Page 1**

  .
- Review if any of the lines have adjustments. Consolidation adjustments usually occur if the consolidation structure is incorrect.
- To check the consolidation structure, go to 

  **Organizer****States**

  . Select **State and City Activation/Consolidation** in the **Nebraska** row subview in Column E – Entity Type.
- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****Nebraska****Form 1120N-Corporate Income Tax Return**

  . The amount in **1120N Sch IV Line 3 Gross Profit Column (I) Subtotal** must be equal to the sum of all the gross profits of all members.
- Once reviewed and corrected, do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

note

* If e-filing, any consolidation adjustments must be removed because the state schema only allows for Combined Subtotal, Elimination, and Combined Income Total on Schedule IV but doesn’t include consolidation adjustments.
* A top consolidation allows 1 parent, 1 elimination, at least 1 subsidiary and may also have a subconsolidation. Entity types of Corporate single entity, division, and top consolidation should not be included under a top consolidation.

# S4-0012 e-file error

```
*S4-0012: Form 1120N Schedule IV, Column III Combined Income line 27 must equal the result of Column I Subtotal line 27 minus Column II Eliminations line 27.
```

This happens when Form 1120N Page 1 has adjustments on any line of this form, if any adjustments exist the return will need to be paper filed. The state schema allows for Combined Subtotal, Elimination, and Combined income Total on Schedule IV but does not include consolidation adjustments.

## Solution 1

- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****Nebraska****Form 1120N Pg 1**

  .
- Right click and review all lines for any adjustments that may exist.
- Go to **Consolidated Returns**, **Step 1 – What to Consolidate**.
- Select **Subsidiary Listing Complete**.
- Go to **Step 4 - Review Preconsol Checklist**. Select **Compute subsidiaries with compute pending**, then **Compute all subsidiaries now**.
- Go to **Step 5 – Consolidate!** and select **Consolidate**.
- Recreate the e-file.

## Solution 2

- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****Nebraska****Form 1120N Pg 1**

  .
- Right click and review any line for adjustments.
- Review the members and make sure no adjustments exist; everything must be in balance.
- If there are adjustments, go to **States Combined Returns** and select **State Consolidation Steps**.
- Select **Delete Previously transferred state data**.
- Select **Nebraska**.
- Go to 

  **Organizer****Consolidated Returns****Step 1 – What to Consolidate**

  .
- Select **Subsidiary Listing Complete**.
- Go to **Step 4 - Review Preconsol Checklist**. Select **Compute subsidiaries with compute pending**, then **Compute all subsidiaries now**.
- Go to **Step 5 – Consolidate!** and select **Consolidate**.
- Recreate the e-file.

articles.title: BT-Summary Overpayment e-file error
articles.body_md:
# BT-Summary Overpayment e-file error

```
BT-Summary Overpayment: Line 7(a) ‘credit to next year’ cannot be greater than Line 6(a). Please adjust Line 7(1) to be less than or equal to Line 6(a).
```

This happens when BT-Summary Overpayment line 7(a) is greater than line 6(a).

## Solution

- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****New Hampshire****BT-Summary**

  .
- Select **BT-Summary, Page 2**. **Step 4 line 7(a)** can't be greater than **line 6(a)**.
- Adjust line 7(a) to be less than or equal to line 6(a).
- Perform a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

note

New Hampshire added the rule that any overpayment can't exceed the amount on line 6(a). Line 6(a) is 500% times the amount on line 1(c).

articles.title: 200902 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# 200902 e-file error

New Jersey counts tax periods by month. This reject happens when the tax period end date is missing, invalid, or exceeds 12 months. Fiscal year filers and 52/53 week filers often get this error when dates don't align with New Jersey's requirements.

## Error message

```
State NJ
Severity REJECT
State Record
Record Name NA
Form Occurrence No 0
Field Seq No 0
Page No 1
Reject Code 200902
Rule Number 200902
XML Path /ReturnState/ReturnHeaderState/TaxPeriodEndDate
Error Message Header Return Period End Date Missing/Invalid[/STYLE]
```

## Solution

Complete these steps to resolve the reject:



- Go to 

  **Organizer****General Information****Basic Return Information**

  .
- Find the **Dates** section.
- Review the **Fiscal year beginning** and **Fiscal year ending** dates. The period can't exceed 12 months.

  important

  New Jersey doesn't have a 52/53 week filer option. For federal 52/53 week returns, override the dates to match the 12-month return dates used for the federal return.
- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****Common State****General Information****State Dates**

  .
- Locate the **Fiscal Year Date Overrides** section.
- Enter the deemed 12-month return dates used for the federal return.
- If the return still gets rejected, contact the New Jersey Division of Taxation to double check the correct dates.

articles.body_md:
# Error: The field ‘StateofCorp’ with value '0', data is missing

This error appears when the State of Incorporation field contains an invalid value ('0') instead of a valid two-letter state code. Required entity information is missing for the New Jersey return.

## Error message

```
Validation failed on CXXXXXXX5.inx: Form: Header Requirement: State abbreviations, a.k.a. state codes Error: The field 'StateofCorp' with value '0', data is missing. Element Name: StateofCorp XPath: /ReturnState[1]/ReturnHeaderState[1]/Header[1]/StateofCorp[1] XML Fragment: 0 Field Key: 24,906,13,0,0,0,0,0,0 Error Code: 80004005 Error Reason: '0' violates enumeration constraint of 'AL AK AS AZ AR CA CO MP CT DE DC FC FI FM FL GA GU HI ID IL IN IA KS KY LA ME MH MD MA MI MN MS MO MT NE NV NH NJ NM NY NC ND OH OK OR PW PA PR RI SC SD TN TX VI UT VT VA WA WV WI WY AA AE AP'. The element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}StateofCorp' with value '0' failed to parse
```

## Solution

- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****Common State****General Information****Basic Return Information****Entity Information tab**

  .
- Locate the **New Jersey** row.
- Fill out columns **E**, **F**, and **I**.
- Enter the date qualified in state in column **E** using the following format: MM/DD/YYYY.
- Run a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

note

Verify that all required columns (E, F, and I) have valid selections before recreating the e-file.

articles.title: 1095 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# 1095 e-file error

```
Form CIT-1, line 1. Taxable income before federal NOL and special deductions must equal line 28 of federal Form 1120. (1095)
```

This happens when New Mexico Form CIT-1, Page 2, line 1 doesn’t equal Federal Form 1120, Page 1, line 28 amount, or when the extension is either too early or too late to be filed.

## Solution

- Go to the **Organizer**, **States**, **State E-File** folder.
- Select **Enable/Create Returns**, then go to the **Federal Copy** tab.
- If you have selected **Attach a Federal located in a different locator/binder** in **Column B**, look for that Federal return to compare the line items. Don't compare the one within this binder.
- Verify the values entered in the following path.
- Go to the **Tax Forms**, **Federal**, **1120-US Corporation Income Tax Return** folder.
- Select **1120-US Corporation Income Tax Return**, then go to **Page 1**, **Line 28** must match with the New Mexico amount.
- Go to **Tax Forms**, **States**, **New Mexico** folder.
- Select **CIT-1 - Tax Return**, then go to **CIT - 1 Pg 2**,**Line 1** amount.
- Do a full recompute, then recreate the e-file and resubmit.

note

* The Federal 1120, Page 1, line 28 and Form CIT-1, line 1 must match to clear the rejection. Either enter the correct value for line 1 or adjust the federal copy option to reflect the proper numbers.
* You will need to make sure that the values in the Federal that you are using match the New Mexico values as stated in the reject.
* Additionally, the State of New Mexico requires an accepted federal copy of the return to be included. If these changes can't be applied, the client must paper file the return or contact the State of New Mexico to verify the rejection error at 1-866-285-2996.

```
Validation failed on CXXXXXX4.xny:

```

This generally occurs when the tax office has already transmitted this return and the reject is simply a duplicate filing. It also occurs when the preparer is attempting to amend the Form **1120** and has failed to mark the return as an amended return.

- In Organizer, select 

  **States****Common State****Basic Return Information**

  .
- Open the **Signature Information** tab.
- Go to the row for **New York**, Column L and enter the **Signature Date** for all members.
- If this is a consolidation then select **Subview** in the field and verify all members and enter their information.
- Do a full recompute of all members, reconsolidate, then create the e-file.

- Select **Add**, then select the **Attachment Jurisdiction**: choose **New York**.

- Use a **Predefined description**, and select **UPLOAD**.
- Do a full recompute, and recreate the e-file.

note

On the CT-3-page 2, Section C, don't override any of these boxes or your return will be rejected.

articles.title: 9497 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# 9497 e-file error

```
New York prohibits from submitting the CT-3-A combined return e-file until all associated CT-3-A/BC subsidiary e-files have been submitted. Our records indicate the subsidiary CT-3-A/BC returns have not yet been submitted. Verify all subsidiary returns have been submitted. If all indicated subsidiary e-files show as having been submitted, there may have been a timing difference. Resubmit the CT-3-A combined return e-file.
```

This happens when you submit the TopCon before the subsidiaries. The system prevents the CT-3-A e-file from being submitted until all the associated CT-3-A/BC subsidiary e-files have been submitted.

## Solution

Let's walk through submitting the subsidiaries first to have them considered complete, and then re-submit the TopCon.

- Go to **Organizer**, **States**, **New York**, **E-file**, and then **Additional Information**.
- Go to the bottom of the screen and select **CT-3-A/BC inclusion list for the CT-3-A to be submitted**. The system reviews this data entry before you can submit the CT-3-A TopCon e-file.
- Correct any locator/binder number for a subsidiary or select to exclude it.

If the subsidiaries are all qualified, wait until their status changes to accepted, and then re-submit the TopCon.

articles.title: Error: Field 'CityNm' is unexpected
articles.body_md:
# Error: Field 'CityNm' is unexpected

This e-file validation error occurs when you populate both address fields in the entity information. The system expects only 1 address, which causes the CityNm element to appear in an unexpected position in the XML structure.

## Error message

```
Validation failed on: Form: ReturnHeaderState Requirement: City Requirement: Expecting AddressLine1Txt Error: Field 'CityNm' is unexpected Element Name: CityNm XPath: /ReturnState[1]/ReturnHeaderState[1]/Filer[1]/USAddress[1]/CityNm[1] XML Fragment: Atlanta Field Key: 167,1144,2,0,0,0,0,0,0 Error Code: c00ce014 Error Reason: Element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}CityNm' is unexpected according to content model of parent element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}USAddress'. Expecting: {http://www.irs.gov/efile}AddressLine1Txt
```

This error means the system found a city name where it expected a street address, because 2 addresses exist in the entity information.

## Solution

Complete these steps to resolve the validation error:

- Go to 

  **Organizer****General Information****Basic Return Information****Entity Information****Address**

  .
- Delete the contents of 1 address field, keeping only the primary business address.

  important

  Use only 1 address field. Remove the duplicate address before proceeding.
- For consolidated returns, complete the following additional steps:
- At the TopCon, open 

  **Organizer****States****State and City Activation/Consolidation****State and City Activation/Consolidation**

  .
- Find **NY**, right-click **Column C**, and select **subview**.
- Open and lower members not yet set up and add them.
- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****State Combined Returns****State Consolidation Steps****Option 6: Delete previously transferred state data**

  .
- Select **New York** from the state list.
- Go to 

  **Organizer****Consolidated Returns****Step 1 - What to Consolidate****Consolidated Return List**

  .
- Select **Subsidiary Listing Complete**.
- Go to 

  **Step 4 - Review Preconsol Checklist****Out of balance and compute pending**

  .
- Select **Compute all subsidiaries now**.
- Go to 

  **Step 5 - Consolidate!****Consolidate**

  .
- Recompute the return and recreate the e-file.
- Verify the e-file status shows as qualified before submitting.

articles.title: X0000-001 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# X0000-001 e-file error

```
Generating the New York Combined Franchise Tax Return CT-3-A e-file also generates a Member’s Detail Report CT-3-A/BC for each subsidiary. The subsidiary e-file submission is NOT automatic. Each CT-3-A/BC MUST be submitted individually.
```

This happens when CT-3-A/BC in each member is not submitted individually.

## Solution

important

New York consolidations require a CT-3-A combined electronic file and separate Form CT-3-A/C electronic files for each subsidiary that is required to pay the fixed dollar minimum tax. The CT-3-A/BC e-files should be submitted at the same time as the NY combined e-file.

* To resolve this error, ensure that each member is submitted individually and wait until their status is changed to **Accepted** state.
* Once each member status has been changed to **Accepted** status, then you can qualify for the Topcon locator.
* To qualify each member, go through the following steps.

- In the member level go to **Organizer**, **General Information** folder.
- Select **Basic Return Information**.
- Go to the **Entity Information** tab in the **Return / Entity Type** section.
- Make sure the **Entity Type** is **Single**.
- Recompute and submit the return.
- Once the **E-file status** is changed to **Accepted** consolidate the Topcon.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: Error: Field ‘PrimaryPINEnteredByCd’ is unexpected
articles.body_md:
# Error: Field ‘PrimaryPINEnteredByCd’ is unexpected

This e-file validation error appears when the North Carolina return expects a signature but gets an unexpected PIN field instead.

## Error message

```
Validation failed on CXXXXXX5.inc: Form: ReturnHeaderState Requirement: Expecting Signature Error: Field 'PrimaryPINEnteredByCd' is unexpected Element Name: PrimaryPINEnteredByCd XPath: /ReturnState\[1]/ReturnHeaderState\[1]/SignatureOption\[1]/SignaturePIN\[1]/PrimaryPINEnteredByCd\[1] XML Fragment: ERO Field Key: 139,986,13,0,0,0,0,0,0 Error Code: c00ce014 Error Reason: Element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}PrimaryPINEnteredByCd' is unexpected according to content model of parent element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}SignaturePIN'. Expecting: {http://www.irs.gov/efile}Signature
```

## Solution

- Go to

  **Organizer****States****North Carolina****E-file****Additional Information**

  .
- Go to the **Business Representative (Mandatory)** section.
- Select a **PIN Type** other than None Selected, such as **Practitioner PIN** or **Self-Select PIN**.
- If you have a state issued PIN, mark the **PIN Entered By** checkbox and enter the PIN in the field.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: NCCD401S-2161 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# NCCD401S-2161 e-file error

## Error

```
[CD-401S] For each Schedule K Shareholder, line 13 must equal the sum of lines 11 and 12 multiplied by 0.0525 (with the result rounded to the nearest whole number), when all of the following conditions are met: Line 3b contains "Yes", Both lines 14 and 15 contain "No", The sum of lines 11 and 12 is greater than zero. (NCCD401S-2161)
```

## Cause

If Form CD-401S, Sch K Detail, Line 3b includes “Yes” and both lines 14 and 15 contain “No” (that is, the shareholder is a resident and not filing the NC-NA in this year or a previous tax year), then Line 13 must equal the sum of lines 11 and 12 multiplied by 0.05499.

## Solution

- In the **Organizer**, go to **States**, then **North Carolina**.
- Select **Shareholder Information**, then the shareholder's name.
- In **Shareholder Information**, mark the **Compute Income tax for this shareholder** checkbox.
- Answer **no** to the following questions:


  - **Is the Form NC-NA filed for this shareholder with the return?**
  - **Has Form NC-NA filed for this shareholder in a previous tax year?**
- Do a full recompute, recreate the e-file, and resubmit the return.

# NCCD405-1284 e-file error

**Solution**

- Go to **Tax forms**,**States**, then the **North Carolina** folder.
- Select the **Form CD-405**, **Page 2** tab, then go to the **Sch B** section.
- Go to **Line 24C Payments and Credits - Partnership (include Form D-403, NC K-1)**.

- Since this line is populating, you will need to paper file this return and attach a copy of **(D-403) NC K-1** to support the amount on Form **CD-405 Page 2 Schedule B line 24c**.
- To remove from the organizer, go to **Organizer**, **States**, then the **North Carolina** folder.
- Go to the **Received Income** folder.
- Go to the **D403 K-1** folder and select **Add new D403 K-1**.
- Enter the amount from line 24C to the Nonresident's share of net tax paid by the manager of the partnership.
- Run a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

articles.body_md:
# F40-013 e-file error

```
For filing methods b1 and c1, the aggregate of all columns line 14 or 16 (SFW) must equal the total factor on lines 14a or 16a (SFW).
```

This happens when the sum of the members’ 1120 North Dakota Form 40, Page 7, line 14 doesn’t equal what is shown on the TopCon's Form 40, Page 7, line 14.

## Solution

- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****North Dakota**

  .
- Select **Composite Report**, then **Schedule CR**.
- Select **Detail**, then **40, Page 7**. and check each member’s line 14.
- Update the amounts on each member's locator to ensure that the total sum matches the figure found on TopCon's form 40, Page 7, line 14. To verify this:


  - Go to 

    **Tax Forms****States****North Dakota**

    .
  - Select **Combined Report**, **Schedule CR**, then **40, Page 7, line 14**.
- After making corrections at each member's locator, consolidate the return at TopCon, and recreate the e-file.

note

If there's a difference with the amount, you'll need to file the return on paper.

articles.title: OH-MNP10-037 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# OH-MNP10-037 e-file error

## Error

```
The historical credit carryforward amount for the municipal corporation indicated cannot exceed the tax liability regardless of the total carryforward amount available for the current taxable year. Remaining carryforward amounts will be available for use in preceding taxable years. Please correct and retransmit.(OH-MNP10-037)
```

## Cause

The historical Credit Carryforward can't be greater than the Tax Liability. This is an e-file limitation imposed by the state of Ohio.

## Solution

- In the **Tax Forms**, select **Cities**.
- Select **Ohio Generic Cities**, **OH**, then **Ohio MNP**.
- Check the **Consolidated totals** line on Form MNP10, Page 3.


  - If you find an error, fix it. Then recompute, recreate the e-file, and re-submit the return.
  - If the line is correct, contact the jurisdiction for further clarification.

# F512-009 e-file error

```
F512-009: Form 512, Part 1, line 30, Column B(TaxableIncome, StateAmount) should equal line 11, Column B(TotalIncome, StateAmount) minus line 27, Column B (TotalDeductions, StateAmount) minus line 29a
```

This happens when in the state Oklahoma F512-009 is that the value on **Form 512, Part 1, line 30, Column B (Taxable Income, State Amount)** doesn’t correctly result from the required calculation.

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Oklahoma**.
- Select **Return Options**, then**COMPUTE OPTIONS**.
- Clear the 2nd checkbox for line **Income is derived from the conduct of business in more than one state (unitary) (Part 2)**.
- Do a full recompute.
- Then mark the 1st checkbox for line **All income is within Oklahoma for corporations domesticated in Oklahoma**.
- Do a full recompute, and recreate the e-file.

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Oregon**.
- Select**E-file**, then **Attachments**, then **Summary**.
- Select **Attach PDF**.
- Select the file and then **Delete**.

articles.body_md:
# E-file diagnostic: Philadelphia electronic payment methods

```
The Department of Revenue accepts the following electronic payment methods:
Automated Clearing House (ACH) debit transactions, credit and debit card payments, and ACH credit transactions through their banks. To remit electronic payments, register at www.etides.state.pa.us or call Telefile at 8 00-748-8299.

All corporation tax payments of $1,000 or more must be remit a check. Checks and money orders are acceptable for payments less than $1 ,000.

Please make checks and money orders payable to the PA Department of Revenue and include
the Account ID, Entity ID (EIN/SSN or 10-digit Revenue ID), phone number, tax type and tax period end date for which the payment is intended.

Mail payments to the PA Department of Revenue, PO BOX 2804 04, Harrisburg, PA 17128-0404
```

This happens when e-file is created for Philadelphia while the e-file for the state of Pennsylvania is also enabled.

## Solution

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **State E-file**.
- Select **Enable/Create Returns**.
- Un-check Column C, Enable for Pennsylvania and then select Column B, Create for Philadelphia.

# PA1120-024 e-file error

```
RCT-101 is present and Federal Form 1120, 1120S or 1120F is not present.

- Go to 

  **Organizer****States**

  .
- Go to **Enable/Create Returns**.
- Go to the **Federal Copy** tab.
- Enter the federal information in Columns F, M, N, and O.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

note

The state requires a federal copy, so if you filed the federal return on paper, you'll need to file the state return on paper as well.

articles.title: c00ce014 e-file error Element name: DateOfIncorporation
breadcrumb: c00ce014 e-file error Element name: DateOfIncorporation
articles.body_md:
# c00ce014 e-file error Element name: DateOfIncorporation

## Error

```
Element 'DateOfIncorporation' is unexpected according to content model of parent element 'SchSC1120D.' Expecting: OutStandingShares, DirectorAndOfficerInfo.
```

## Cause

Officer's name, title, and full address is missing.

## Solution

South Carolina requires at least 1 officer with name, title, and full address be included in the e-file.

For combined returns, at least 1 officer's information be entered in each member of the combined group.

- Go to **Organizer**, **Income and Deductions**, **Deductions**, **Officers' Compensation**, **Individual Officers**.
- Select **Add new Officer**.
- Enter an officer name, then select **Save**.
- Enter the officer's title and address.
- Select Federal and Selected States in the **Select option to apply officer information** section.
- Find **Select States** and select South Carolina.
- Perform a full re-compute, re-create the e-file, then re-submit.

important

If you receive this error for a divisional consolidation, enter the officer's name, title, and address in a division return, then re-consolidate.

breadcrumb: E-file diagnostic: Schedule D/J: South Carolina requires at least 1 officer with name
articles.body_md:
# E-file diagnostic: Schedule D/J: South Carolina requires at least 1 officer with name

```
Schedule D/J: South Carolina requires at least one officer with name, title, and full address be included in the return. For combined returns, you will need to enter officer information for each member
```

This requirement appears to occur when a business or organization is filing a tax return in South Carolina, specifically a Schedule D/J return, which is likely related to the state's corporate or business tax filing requirements.

## Solution

In these situations, the business needs to provide the name, title, and full address of at least 1 officer for each member of the combined return.

- Go to **Organizer**, **Income and Deductions**, **Deductions** folder.
- Select **Officers Compensation**, **Individual Officers**, then **Select/Add Name**.
- Option to **Apply Officer Information** needs to be on.
- Select **Federal and Selected States** or **States Only**.
- Select **Select States**.
- Mark the checkbox for **South Carolina**.
- Enter the **address**, **city**, **postal code**, and **country**.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: 3696 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# 3696 e-file error

```
Reject Code 3696 : Invalid Security Information. Webfile number or last reported revenue is incorrect or blank. Contact Texas Comptroller @1-800-442-3453 for your WebFile Number. Line Number: H.
```

## Solution

- In Organizer, select **States**, then **Texas**.
- Select **E-file**, then **Additional Information**, then **Preparer Validation**.

- If there isn't a webfile number or the total revenue on the latest return is blank, enter the **Webfile number**and enter an amount for the **Total revenue on latest return**.
- Perform a full recompute, recreate the e-file and resubmit the return.

  note

  If you don’t have a Webfile number or last year’s total revenue, you will need to contact the Texas Comptroller at (800) 442-3453.

articles.title: 3703 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# 3703 e-file error

```
Since this is a combined report, the 05-165 form is required to be filed.
```

The reject occurs because the 05-165 is not required with the 2nd extension. As such, we don’t send it with the 2nd extension e-file. If Texas has no record of the 1st extension being e-filed, it reads the 2nd extension as the 1st and expects the 05-165.

## Solution 1

* Contact the state and provide the submission ID of the 1st extension.
* Once the state corrects the issue of the 1st extension on their side, then you can recreate the TX 2nd extension and re-submit.
* Contact the Texas Comptroller at 800-442-3453.

## Solution 2

If the 1st extension is not e-filed, consider paper-filing the 2nd extension.

# Accounting year end date e-file error

Accounting year end date: If you are filing an annual franchise tax report, the accounting year end date cannot be greater than January 4 of the report year.

The report year pertains to the year the tax return was filed in. For example, if the return's being filed on 11/15/2023, then the report year would be 2023.

- Review and correct the **Accounting year end date**.
- Perform a full re-compute, re-create the e-file, then re-submit.

# Form 05-102 e-file error

```
Information should not be entered in the top consolidation. It should be entered in the lower level entities.
```

## Solution

Check these following items to resolve this diagnostic.

- Go to **Organizer**, **State Franchise Tax**, **Texas Franchise**, **Information Report**, and then **Common Information**. Remove any information from these screens.
- Review officer entries entered in **Organizer**, **State Franchise Tax**, **Texas Franchise**, **Information Report**, **Public Information Report**, **Officers, Directors, or Members**. Officers entered in this section of the return apply to TopCon, which will prompt the diagnostic.
- In the TopCon, go to **Organizer**, **Income and Deductions**, **Deductions**, **Officers' Compensation**, **Individual Officers**, **Officer Name** and make sure no officers have been selected to apply to all states or selectively applied to Texas.

Once these items are reviewed and adjusted where needed, perform a full re-compute.

articles.title: Error: The field ‘Date’ with value '0', data is missing Form 05-102
breadcrumb: Error: The field ‘Date’ with value '0', data is missing Form 05-102
articles.body_md:
# Error: The field ‘Date’ with value '0', data is missing Form 05-102

This error happens when the Signature Date field on Texas Form 05-102 contains '0' instead of a valid date. You haven't entered or transferred the signatory date to the subsidiary returns.

## Error message

```
Validation failed on: Form: Form05-102[3] Signatory[1]/Date[1] Requirement: Base type for a date Error: The field 'Date' with value '0', data is missing. Element Name: Date XPath: /ReturnState[1]/ReturnDataState[1]/Form05-102[3]/Signatory[1]/Date[1] XML Fragment: 0 Field Key: 152,688,5,0,0,0,0,0,0 Error Code: 80004005 Error Reason: Error parsing '0' as date datatype. The element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}Date' with value '0' failed to parse
```

This error may appear multiple times. It references different Form05-102 instances (Form05-102[3], Form05-102[4], Form05-102[5]) when multiple subsidiary returns don't have the signature date.

## Solution

- Go to 

  **Organizer****State Franchise Tax****Texas Franchise****Information Report****Common Information****Signatory Information**

  Section.
- Enter the **Signature Date**.
- Select **Transfer to Parent and Subs**.

  tip

  The Transfer to Parent and Subs option copies the signature date to all related entity returns in the consolidated group. This prevents the error from appearing on multiple Form 05-102 instances.
- Run a full recompute by selecting the **recompute** option from the toolbar or menu.
- Reconsolidate the return by selecting the consolidation option from the return menu.
- Recreate the e-file.

articles.title: E-file diagnostic: 154.102.1: Form TC-20, Page 2 - Question 3
breadcrumb: E-file diagnostic: 154.102.1: Form TC-20, Page 2 - Question 3
articles.body_md:
# E-file diagnostic: 154.102.1: Form TC-20, Page 2 - Question 3

```
* 154.102.1: Form TC-20, Page 2 - Question 3 - Information is not fully entered. In parent/single company return, go to Tax Forms/States/Utah/TC-20, Tax Return/Page 2/Question 3/Detail hyperlink/yellow screen. Complete all Mandatory E-file fields. (Note: If no UT organizer data, information already populated for this question is flowing from Common State at Organizer/States/Common State/General Information/50% or More Owner.)
```

This happens when in state Utah Form TC-20 (Utah Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return) in what appears to be tax preparation software. The error indicates that Question 3 on Page 2 of Form TC-20 is incomplete. This question likely relates to ownership information for the corporation.

## Solution 1

- In the parent return, go to **Organizer**, **States**, and the **Utah** folder.
- Select **General Information**, **50% or More Owned**, then the **corporation** name.
- Be sure all address fields are filled out, even **address line 2 and c/o**. If there is nothing to put in, such as, **no province** or **state**, use **NA**.
- Do a full recompute, and recreate the e-file.

note

Enter this information only at the **parent** level for consolidated returns. Don't enter it at the **topcon** level or **subsidiary** level.

## Solution 2

- In **Organizer**, select **Consolidated Returns**, then **Step 1-what to consolidate**.
- Select **Subsidiary listing complete**.
- Go to **Step 4 Review Preconsol Checklist**, then **Out of Balance and compute Pending**.
- Select **Compute all subsidiaries now**.
- Go to the **Step 5 Consolidate** screen and select **Consolidate**.
- Enter either a full **Domestic** or **Foreign Address**.
- Do a full recompute, and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: Error: Field 'RoutingTransitNumber' is unexpected
articles.body_md:
# Error: Field 'RoutingTransitNumber' is unexpected

This validation error occurs when you e-file a Utah 1120 extension without complete bank information or with a zero payment amount. Utah requires a payment with extension e-files.

## Error message

```
Validation failed on CXXXXXX.iut1: Requirement: Expecting Checking, Savings Error: Field 'RoutingTransitNumber' is unexpected Element Name: RoutingTransitNumber XPath: /ReturnState[1]/FinancialTransaction[1]/StatePayment[1]/RoutingTransitNumber[1] XML Fragment: 019999999 Field Key: 154,543,6,0,0,0,0,0,0 Error Code: c00ce014 Error Reason: Element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}RoutingTransitNumber' is unexpected according to content model of parent element '{http://www.irs.gov/efile}StatePayment'. Expecting: {http://www.irs.gov/efile}Checking, {http://www.irs.gov/efile}Savings
```

## Solution

If there's a payment due, complete all bank information:

- Go to 

  **Organizer****States****Common State****General Information****Bank Information****Extension debit tab**

  .
- For the state row, enter the account type (**Checking** or **Savings**), routing number, and account number.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: 500-042 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# 500-042 e-file error

```
Form 500: Rule Number: 500-042 If the corporation is not a multistate, Income Tax on Line 9 must equal .06 x Line 7.
```

This happens when apportionment computation doesn’t match to the actual apportionment percentage.

## Solution 1

- In Tax Forms, select **States**,**Virginia** then **500 - Virginia Corp. Income Tax Return**.
- Select the **500, Page 2** tab.
- Line 8a needs data that ties out with Sch 500a Section B line 3j.
- Form 500A only populates on the form when:


  - the Property factor is less than 100%
  - the payroll factor is less than 100%
  - the Sales factor is less than 100%.

note

Make sure line 8(b) is less the 100%.

## Solution 2

- In Tax Forms, select **States**, then **Virginia**, then **Apportionment Forms**.
- Select **500, Sch A - Multistate Corporation**.
- Go to Section B, line 1, column C.
- If 100% is entered here, then the amount won’t transfer to Form 500 Page 2 line 8a from 500 Sch A Section B line 3j.
- Remove the 100% to clear the reject.
- Perform a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

articles.body_md:
# c00ce020 Element name: ConsolReturnChkbx and c00ce169 Element name: CombinedReturnChkbx e-file errors

## Errors

```
c00cd020: Required attribute 'referenceDocumentId' is missing.
```

```
c00cd169: 'BinaryAttach0000XXX1 BinaryAttach0000XXX1N1 BinaryAttach0000XXX1N2' violates pattern constraint of '[A-Za-z0-9:\.\-]{1,30}.' The attribute 'referenceDocumentId' with value 'BinaryAttach0000XXX1 BinaryAttach0000XXX1N1 BinaryAttach0000XXX1N2' failed to parse.
```

## Cause

For consolidated/combined returns, the state of Virginia requires the attachment of a copy of the consolidated/combined return 500 as a PDF document named Form 500.pdf.

## Solution

- Go to **Organizer**, **States**, **Virginia**, **E-file**, **Attachments**, and then **Summary**.
- Select **Attach PDF**, then **Add**.
- Select Virginia for the **Attachment Jurisdiction**.
- Select **Next**, go to the PDF file, then select **Open**.
- Select Form500 Consolidated/Combined Return Attachment, whichever is applicable, for the **Predefined description**.

  note

  Predefined descriptions are for required attachments only. For all others, use user-defined descriptions.
- Select **Upload**, then **Done**.
- Perform a full re-compute, re-create the e-file, then re-submit.

articles.title: CIT-120-125 e-file error
articles.body_md:
# CIT-120-125 e-file error

```
WV E-file: CIT-120-125 Sum of the All Adjusted Sales for each entity must equal to combined everywhere Adjusted Sales amount Navigation:Tax form >West Virginia > Combined Report > Apportionment- member informtion. sum of total adjusted sales col 2 everywhere for each member should add up to amount shown on CIT-120APT Col 2 line 6.
```

This happens when in West Virginia the sum of each entity's Everywhere adjusted sales (found in Column 2 for each member) is not equal to the total Everywhere adjusted sales reported on Form CIT-120APT, Column 2, Line 6.

## Solution 1

- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****West Virginia**

  .
- Select **Form CIT-120APT**, then **CIT-120APT, Page 2** on the “within” and “everywhere” apportionment amounts to look for amounts in the eliminations.
- If you have any amounts in **Elim**, remove them and adjust the amounts entered in the other member returns.
- Do a full recompute.
- Reconsolidate the Top Consolidation locator by Step 1 - What to Consolidate , Step 4 - Review Preconsol Checklist and Step 5 – Consolidate .
- Recreate the e-file.

## Solution 2

- Make sure there are no elimination amounts for property, payroll, and sales.
- Go to 

  **Tax Forms****States****West Virginia**

  .
- Select **Combined Report**, **Apportionment - Member Information**, then **Member Apportionment**. Subsidiary, Apportionment, Sub Detail are populated for every member. Enter **NONE** for any entities without apportionment.
- Do a full re-compute and recreate the e-file.

## Solution 3

- Select **Organizer**, then **State Combined Returns**.
- Select **State Consolidation Steps**, **6 - Press Delete previously transferred state data**, then **West Virginia**.
- Select **Organizer**, then **Consolidated Returns**.
- Select **Step 1 - What to Consolidate**. In the **Consolidated Return List** section, select **Subsidiary Listing complete**.
- Select **Organizer**, **Consolidated Returns**, **Step 4 - Review Preconsol Checklist**, **Out of balance and compute pending**, then **Compute all Subsidiaries now**.
- Select **Organizer**, **Consolidated Returns**, then **Step 5 – Consolidate**. In the **Consolidation** section, select **Consolidate**.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

articles.body_md:
# E-file diagnostic: Wisconsin requires that Form 6, part II, Line 2b foot horizontally

```
Electronic Filing: The State of Wisconsin requires that Form 6, Part II, Line 2b, State taxes accrued or paid foot horizontally. The amounts from the parent and subsidiaries on this return do not match the amount in the combined column. The amounts for the parents and subsidiaries should be adjusted to match the combined amount
```

This diagnostic appears when the amounts for state taxes accrued or paid on Form 6, Part II, Line 2b don't foot horizontally. The State of Wisconsin requires that the parent and subsidiary amounts match the combined column total.

## Solution

Follow these steps to resolve this diagnostic:

- In the **Tax Forms** section, select **States**, then **Wisconsin**.
- Select **Combined Report**, **6 – Combined Corporation Return, 6, Page 5**, and review the **Line 2b Combined Totals** column.
- Right-click on **Line 2b Combined** and select **Subview** to review the lower member totals that are inconsistent with the **Combined column line 2b Taxes Amount**.
- Go to the **Organizer** and select **States**, then **Wisconsin**.
- Select **State Adjustments**, then **State Accrued or paid (override)**. Enter amounts in the parent and/or subsidiaries to ensure the total equals the combined column amount for Line 2b.
- Reconsolidate the return and recreate the e-file.

articles.title: E-file diagnostic: Limitation on Business Interest Expense under Section 163(j): Wisconsin
breadcrumb: E-file diagnostic: Limitation on Business Interest Expense under Section 163(j): Wisconsin
articles.body_md:
# E-file diagnostic: Limitation on Business Interest Expense under Section 163(j): Wisconsin

```
Limitation on Business Interest Expense Under Section 163(j): Wisconsin has not adopted the Internal Revenue Code (IRC) limitation on the deduction of net business interest expense under IRC sec. 163(j). The State of Wisconsin has informed us that adjustments for Form 4 should be made on Schedules 4V, line 10 (other) or 4W, line 14 (other). Adjustments for Form 5s should be made on Schedule 5K, line 1, column C and adjustments for Form 6 should be made on Part II, lines 2j or 4n. Form 6 adjustments must be made at the parent or subsidiary level and cannot be made directly on the topcon. Note that the federal amount now reflects CARES changes.
```

This diagnostic appears because Wisconsin has not adopted the Internal Revenue Code (IRC) limitation on deducting net business interest expense under IRC Section 163(j).

## Solution

This is a severe diagnostic but will not prevent you from e-filing. Follow these steps to resolve it:

- Select **Organizer**, **States**, then the **State and City Activation/Consolidation** folder.
- Select **State and City Activation/Consolidation**, then go to the **States** tab. Right-click on **Entity Type (column E)** and select **Subview** to view lower members.
- Verify you have the 1 Parent, 1 Elim and the remaining entities are subsidiaries. Change **Entity Type** if needed.
- If you changed the entity type from **Single** to **Subsidiary**, perform a full recompute.
- Go to the **Top Consolidation** locator and select **Consolidate**.
- Go to the **Organizer** and select **Consolidated Returns**.


  - Select **What to Consolidate**, **Consolidated Return List**, then **Subsidiary Listing Complete**.
  - Go to the **Organizer**and select **Consolidated Returns**.
  - Select **Review Preconsol Checklist**, **Out of balance and compute pending**, then **Compute all Subsidiaries now**.
  - Select **Consolidate**.
- Recreate the e-file.

note

You can't have a single entity in a Top Consolidation Locator.

articles.title: Correct validation errors with GoTo
articles.body_md:
# Correct validation errors with GoTo

Generate a validation file that uses GoTo functionality to go to the source of e-file errors and correct them efficiently.

When you create an e-file, the system identifies and reports validation errors. However, these error messages can be difficult to interpret, and locating where to make corrections may not be clear.

GoTo functionality solves this problem by letting you select a validation error and automatically go to its source—whether that's an Organizer field or a tax form. This saves time and eliminates guesswork when resolving e-file errors.

Follow these steps to create a validation file and resolve errors:

- Go to 

  **Organizer****Federal E-file****Error Checking**

  .
- Select **Generate Validation File**.
- For state returns, create the XML file with GoTo functionality separately in the 

  **State E-file****Validation**

   spreadsheet.
- After the system creates the validation file, go to 

  **View****Diagnostics****E-file Validation Errors**

  .
- Select a validation error to go directly to its source (Organizer or Tax Form field).
- If the error appears in a Tax Form field, select the link to the Organizer field and update it.
- Repeat these steps until you eliminate all validation errors.
- Select **Create E-file** to generate the final XML file for transmission.

  note

  * GoTo functionality is not available for XML files you create using **Create E-file**. To restore GoTo functionality, regenerate the validation file using the previous steps.
  * GoTo functionality doesn’t cover all XML validation errors. Product teams review and update this feature each filing season to include newly released errors.

articles.title: E-file error: Federal return copy requirements
breadcrumb: E-file error: Federal return copy requirements
articles.body_md:
# E-file error: Federal return copy requirements

There are a few different messages you might get regarding attaching a federal return to the state. Some examples are:

```
Complete information must be made for Federal Copy Requirements.
```

```
Copy of Federal Return: You have selected the option to "Attach the federal XML created in the federal organizer", but the federal XML is not qualified. Create a qualified federal XML or select the option to "Attach a federal XML created just for state"
```

```
Federal Copy Requirements: Enter FEIN, Locator or Binder Number or Account Number.
```

This happens when a qualified XML copy of the federal return isn't attached to the state return.

## Solution

If you've prepared the federal return in the program, open that return and create an XML e-file:

- In 

  Organizer

  , go to the **Federal E-file** folder.
- Select **Create E-file**, then the **Create Federal E-file** button.
- Make sure the return qualifies and is clear of any validation errors and reject diagnostics.

Once the federal XML is created and cleared of any errors, open the state return to attach it:

- Go to **Organizer**, **States**, then the **State E-File** folder.
- Select **Enable/Create Returns** and go to the **Federal Copy** tab.
- In the state row you're getting the error for:


  - Select an option for **Federal Copy** in column **B**.
  - Enter the **Federal EIN**, the **Locator Number**, and the **Account Number** in the respective columns.
- Do a full recompute and recreate the e-file.

This information must be filled out even if you are attaching the Federal XML created in the Federal Organizer or using the State Copy option. You can find the locator number in the Organizer under 

**Help****About 1120 Tax**

 or 

**Help****About 1065 Tax**

. The Return Number listed here is the locator number.

# E-file error: State requires federal e-file to be clean of validation errors

Federal Efile Validation Errors: State requires Federal Efile to be clean of validation errors Recreate the State Electronic File for this diagnostic to get cleared.

- Enter the **Federal EIN**, **Locator Number**, and **Account Number** from the locator that has the accepted federal return.
- Perform a full re-compute, re-create the e-file, then re-submit.
